headline: Om Power Transmission shareholders approve ₹1,000 crore asset charge
hook: Debt financing secured for Om Power Transmission
summary: Shareholders of Om Power Transmission have officially approved a proposal to create a charge on company assets worth ₹1,000 crore. This move typically facilitates the securing of debt or credit facilities from lenders. The asset charge allows the company to leverage its holdings to support operational or expansion capital requirements.
